Interview with Ada Example

We sat down with Ada Example, who runs a chip company, to ask where the industry is going.

"I think every company will run an AI factory within five years," she said. "The people who know how to operate one will be the hardest to hire."

The interviewer disagreed: "Most companies will rent what they need." Example laughed and said the two views are not that far apart, since somebody still has to run the thing that is rented.
